| Bug | Root Cause | Fix |

| **Clean too aggressive** | `<Compile Remove="**\*.g.cs" />` removed all `.g.cs` files (including `Constants.g.cs`) | Scoped removal to only `@(ProtoFile)`-derived paths in `$(IntermediateOutputPath)`, plus `<Delete>` |
| **FileWrites not tracked** | `FileWrites` declared in a static `ItemGroup` isn't persisted to `.FileListAbsolute.txt` | Moved `FileWrites` inside the `GenerateProtoCode` target |
